HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a Kenyan water body mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. River Beas
   B. River Ganga
   C. River Rijubalika
   D. Lake Victoria

2. Which element is called Prithvi? (1 mark)
   A. Fire
   B. Air
   C. Water
   D. Earth

3. In a maize farm, what does the sun's heat that ripens the crop represent among the elements? (1 mark)
   A. Agni
   B. Jal
   C. Akash
   D. Prithvi

4. Why can children with special needs join the tree planting activity? (1 mark)
   A. They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   B. Only adults can plant
   C. They must not be included
   D. They are too weak

5. Which Enlightened Being is Jain? (1 mark)
   A. Parshvanath
   B. Narsimha
   C. Prahlad
   D. Guru Ram Das

6. What is an Avtar? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of tree
   B. A daily prayer
   C. A holy river
   D. A form in which God is believed to come to earth

7. What does the word Enlightened mean in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Very rich
   B. Very loud
   C. Very tall
   D. Full of the light of true knowledge

8. From where did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. The sky at noon
   B. A river
   C. A boat
   D. A pillar in the palace

9. What does Asteya mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fast all day
   B. Sit still
   C. Sing every day
   D. Do not take what is not given

10. What is the lesson of Bharat refusing the throne? (1 mark)
   A. Take what you like
   B. Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   C. Never obey
   D. Grab wealth

11. Which scripture is a Jain book about the life of Lord Mahavir? (1 mark)
   A. Kalpasutra
   B. Dhammapada
   C. Ramayan
   D. Guru Granth Sahib

12. Who asked that Bharat be made king? (1 mark)
   A. Sita
   B. Ganga
   C. Mahaprajapati
   D. Queen Kaikeyi

13. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Dhammapada: Sikhism
   B. Kalpasutra: Hinduism
   C. Ramayan: Buddhism
   D. Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism

14. Who was the king of Ayodhya in the Ramayan? (1 mark)
   A. Harishchandra
   B. Dasharatha
   C. Hiranyakashipu
   D. Suddhodana

15. Who was Sigala? (1 mark)
   A. A king of Ayodhya
   B. A Sikh Guru
   C. A young man taught by the Buddha
   D. A Jain monk

16. Which of these should you do first when learning a mantra? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   B. Say it very fast
   C. Guess the words
   D. Skip the words

17. On which festival do many students pray to Saraswati? (1 mark)
   A. Paryushan
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Vasant Panchami
   D. Maha Shivratri

18. What does mata mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. Father
   C. Mother
   D. Friend

19. What is darshan? (1 mark)
   A. Paying fees
   B. Looking at the murti with respect
   C. Running around
   D. Leaving early

20. What does the Twameva prayer teach us about God? (1 mark)
   A. God cares for us like a parent and friend
   B. God is only a king
   C. God is far and angry
   D. God is a stranger

21. What is the murti in a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. A seat
   B. A lamp
   C. A book
   D. A statue of God

22. What are bhajans? (1 mark)
   A. Maps
   B. Sports
   C. Exams
   D. Devotional songs

23. What should passengers do with rubbish? (1 mark)
   A. Drop it on the road
   B. Throw it out of the window
   C. Keep it until you find a bin
   D. Leave it on the seat

24. Which is honest behaviour with technology? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your personal details with strangers
   B. Copying someone's work
   C. Asking permission before using a device
   D. Sending unkind messages

25. On which date is International Yoga Day? (1 mark)
   A. 12 December
   B. 1 June
   C. 21 June
   D. 25 December

26. What does Pranayam mean? (1 mark)
   A. Body posture
   B. Song
   C. Prayer
   D. Breathing exercise

27. Which pose do you start Sasankasana from? (1 mark)
   A. Vajra Asana
   B. Lying down
   C. Standing
   D. A handstand

28. Who should guide children in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody
   B. A trained teacher or trusted adult
   C. A friend who has never tried
   D. A stranger

29. How do you sit in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Kneel and sit on your heels
   B. Sit cross-legged
   C. Lie down
   D. Stand on your hands

30. What is the correct way to sit for Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. With a straight back and relaxed body
   B. Lying on the stomach
   C. Standing on one leg
   D. Slouching

31. What does Prani mean? (1 mark)
   A. A plant only
   B. A living being
   C. A stone
   D. A river

32. What does Dharma mean? (1 mark)
   A. The right way of living
   B. A river
   C. A sport
   D. A festival

33. What does Artha mean? (1 mark)
   A. War
   B. Prayer
   C. A river
   D. Honest wealth and the things we need

34. What does Utsav mean? (1 mark)
   A. Festival
   B. Yoga
   C. Prayer
   D. River

35. What is the first line of the Kenyan National Anthem? (1 mark)
   A. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   B. Twameva mata cha pita twameva
   C. Ya Kundendu Tushara
   D. Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah

36. Which mistake is common about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing it is for Shiva
   B. Knowing about fasting
   C. Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   D. Knowing it is in Phalguna

37. What is done to the Shiva Linga on Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. It is thrown in a river
   B. It is painted red
   C. It is covered
   D. It is bathed with water and milk

38. Which festival in the lesson is celebrated near the middle of the year on 1 June? (1 mark)
   A. Yoga Day
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Maha Shivratri
   D. Paryushan

39. Which is a good food safety rule? (1 mark)
   A. Wash hands before eating
   B. Leave food in the sun
   C. Eat with dirty hands
   D. Share used cups

40. Ravi is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. Mars
   B. Venus
   C. The Sun
   D. The Moon

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Discuss how people of different faiths show respect for water and trees. (5 marks)

42. Write the Indian names for Sunday and Monday. (2 marks)

43. Explain what the story of King Harishchandra teaches. (3 marks)

44. Explain why the time and place of the defeat of Hiranyakashipu are special in the story. (3 marks)

45. Describe what the Panchang is. (2 marks)

46. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)

47. Explain what Punarjanam means. (3 marks)

48. What is the role of the bell in a Mandir? (2 marks)

49. Explain the meaning of karma. (3 marks)

50. Give three activities to learn about temples. (3 marks)

51. On which date is Madaraka Day and what does Madaraka mean? (2 marks)

52. Give two benefits of daily prayer. (2 marks)

53. Describe what Prince Siddhartha did when a swan was hurt. (3 marks)

54. Describe how to do Bhastrika. (3 marks)

55. Describe how Paryushan Parva is celebrated. (3 marks)

56. Describe how the boy in the example story practised Asteya. (3 marks)

57. What is integrity? (2 marks)

58. Give two of Parshvanath's four rules. (2 marks)

59. Write three ways of conserving water in the community. (3 marks)

60. Match each being with a teaching: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha, Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

61. Match each element to its Sanskrit name: earth, fire, air. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is in Kenya; the other three are in India.

2. D — Earth
   Prithvi is the Sanskrit word for earth, the soil and rocks.

3. A — Agni
   Heat and light belong to Agni.

4. A — They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

5. A — Parshvanath
   Parshvanath is a Tirthankar of Jainism.

6. D — A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   An Avtar is a coming down of God to protect goodness.

7. D — Full of the light of true knowledge
   Enlightened beings are wise and full of true knowledge.

8. D — A pillar in the palace
   The pillar broke open and he appeared.

9. D — Do not take what is not given
   Asteya means not stealing.

10. B — Be humble and do not be greedy for power
   He knew the throne belonged to Ram.

11. A — Kalpasutra
   The Kalpasutra tells the life of Lord Mahavir.

12. D — Queen Kaikeyi
   Kaikeyi reminded the king of two promises.

13. D — Uttaradhyayan Sutra: Jainism
   The Uttaradhyayan Sutra is a Jain scripture.

14. B — Dasharatha
   King Dasharatha ruled Ayodhya.

15. C — A young man taught by the Buddha
   The talk was given to him.

16. A — Listen to a teacher or recording for correct sounds
   Listening helps us say the right sounds.

17. C — Vasant Panchami
   Vasant Panchami honours Saraswati.

18. C — Mother
   Mata means mother and pita means father.

19. B — Looking at the murti with respect
   Darshan is a respectful sight of God.

20. A — God cares for us like a parent and friend
   God is called our mother, father and friend.

21. D — A statue of God
   The murti is a statue or image of God.

22. D — Devotional songs
   Bhajans are songs of prayer.

23. C — Keep it until you find a bin
   Keeping the environment clean is good conduct.

24. C — Asking permission before using a device
   Permission is part of responsible use.

25. C — 21 June
   21 June.

26. D — Breathing exercise
   Pranayam is control of the breath.

27. A — Vajra Asana
   You start sitting on heels.

28. B — A trained teacher or trusted adult
   An expert can prevent injury.

29. A — Kneel and sit on your heels
   You sit on your heels.

30. A — With a straight back and relaxed body
   A straight back helps breathing.

31. B — A living being
   Prani is a living creature.

32. A — The right way of living
   Dharma includes duty, honesty and kindness.

33. D — Honest wealth and the things we need
   Artha is earning in an honest way.

34. A — Festival
   Utsav means festival.

35. A — Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
   The anthem is Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu.

36. C — Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   They are different festivals.

37. D — It is bathed with water and milk
   This is called abhishek.

38. B — Madaraka Day
   1 June is mid-year.

39. A — Wash hands before eating
   Hygiene is important.

40. C — The Sun
   Ravi is the Sun.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hindus honour the Ganga and Tulsi; Sikhs remember the Beas and the Ber tree; Jains honour the Rijubalika and the Sal tree; Buddhists honour the Bodhi tree. All value water and trees and take care of them.
   Working / marking points: Award 1 mark for each faith correctly described, up to 4 marks, and 1 mark for the idea that all faiths show respect.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sunday: Ravivaar. Monday: Somvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gave up his kingdom rather than break his promise and never told a lie, so it teaches that truth is worth more than wealth and comfort.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the promise, 1 mark for truth, 1 mark for the lesson.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha was neither man nor animal, it was neither day nor night, and it happened at the doorway, neither inside nor outside, so the king's gift did not protect him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three details.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Indian traditional calendar book that lists days, months and festival dates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for two points.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punarjanam is rebirth. The soul does not die but takes a new body until it reaches Moksha.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for rebirth, 1 mark for the soul, 1 mark for Moksha.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Worshippers ring it gently to announce that they have arrived.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for ringing, 1 mark for announcing arrival.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: Karma means action. Good actions bring good results and unkind actions bring trouble.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for action, 1 mark for good, 1 mark for unkind.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make a collage of temple pictures, map Mandirs on a sketch map or digital map, draw and colour a Mandir, visit one with permission (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 1 June; power or authority to govern.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us start the day calmly, teaches discipline, makes us thankful and gives peace of mind (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: He pulled out the arrow, nursed the swan and, when it was well, let it go free. He said that saving a life matters more than taking it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for nursing, arrow, letting go free.

54. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit tall, breathe in deeply through the nose, breathe out through the nose with the same force, repeat slowly a few times, and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sitting tall, 1 mark for equal in and out breaths, 1 mark for slow and rest.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains fast, pray and meditate, listen to scriptures such as the Kalpasutra, practise Ahimsa, give to the needy and ask for forgiveness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct practice, up to 3.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: He found a purse with money, did not keep it, and asked around until he found the owner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for three points.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Being honest and doing what is right even when nobody is watching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honesty and 1 mark for doing right when unseen.

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya or Aparigraha (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: Closing taps, mending leaks, collecting rainwater, reusing water on plants, not polluting rivers (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible way.

60. (4 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha: God protects the good. Parshvanath: Ahimsa. Buddha: kindness to the hurt. Guru Ram Das Ji: honest work, equality and service.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: Earth: Prithvi. Fire: Agni. Air: Vayu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.
